<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="TmY4k7f1eeT1n5WN08UZ" name="Page-7"> <mxGraphModel dx="1998" dy="1393" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD

classDef trigger fill:#4A90D9,stroke:#2C5F8A,color:#ffffff,stroke-width:2px;
classDef job fill:#F5F5F5,stroke:#333333,color:#000000;
classDef artifact fill:#F5A623,stroke:#8A5A00,color:#000000;
classDef gate fill:#D9534F,stroke:#7A1F1C,color:#ffffff,stroke-width:2px;
classDef notify fill:#9B59B6,stroke:#5E2D6E,color:#ffffff;
classDef external fill:#7F8C8D,stroke:#4D5656,color:#ffffff,stroke-dasharray: 4 3;

%% ---------- TRIGGERS ----------
T_PR([\"Pull Request → main\"]):::trigger
T_PUSH_MAIN([\"Push → main\"]):::trigger
T_PUSH_TAG([\"Push tag v*\"]):::trigger
T_MANUAL([\"Manual dispatch (release_tag)\"]):::trigger

%% ---------- STAGE 1: CI ----------
J_CI[\"job: ci — Lint / Build / Test<br/>tool: GitHub Actions (pnpm, corepack)<br/>env: staging / production\"]:::job
T_PR --> J_CI
T_PUSH_MAIN --> J_CI
T_PUSH_TAG --> J_CI

%% ---------- STAGE 2A: PR image validation ----------
J_DCHECK[\"job: docker-check<br/>tool: docker/build-push-action<br/>env: staging\"]:::job
ART_LOCAL[(\"local runner image cache<br/>— discarded after job\")]:::artifact
J_CI -->|\"if: pull_request\"| J_DCHECK
J_DCHECK --> ART_LOCAL
J_DCHECK --> N_STATUS

%% ---------- STAGE 2B: staging images ----------
J_DSTAGE[\"job: docker-staging<br/>tool: docker/build-push-action + login-action<br/>env: staging\"]:::job
ART_HUB_STAGING[(\"Docker Hub: vigilcs/umtas<br/>*-staging-latest / *-staging-sha\")]:::artifact
J_CI -->|\"if: pull_request OR push→main\"| J_DSTAGE
J_DSTAGE --> ART_HUB_STAGING
J_DSTAGE --> N_STATUS

%% ---------- STAGE 2C: release images ----------
J_DRELEASE[\"job: docker-release<br/>tool: docker/build-push-action + login-action<br/>env: production\"]:::job
ART_HUB_RELEASE[(\"Docker Hub: vigilcs/umtas<br/>*-&lt;release_tag&gt; / *-sha\")]:::artifact
J_CI -->|\"if: tag push v*\"| J_DRELEASE
J_DRELEASE --> ART_HUB_RELEASE
J_DRELEASE --> N_STATUS

%% ---------- STAGE 3: staging delivery ----------
EXT_WATCHTOWER[\"Watchtower (staging host)<br/>auto-pulls new staging images\"]:::external
ART_HUB_STAGING -.-> EXT_WATCHTOWER

%% ---------- STAGE 4: staging health check ----------
J_HCHECK[\"job: health-check<br/>tool: curl retry loop<br/>env: staging\"]:::job
J_DSTAGE --> J_HCHECK
EXT_WATCHTOWER -.-> J_HCHECK
J_HCHECK --> N_STATUS

N_STATUS[\"job: notify-status<br/>tool: discord-notify.yml\"]:::notify
N_STATUS --> DISCORD[/\"Discord Webhook\"/]:::external

%% ---------- MANUAL RELEASE GATE ----------
GATE{{\"Manual approval gate<br/>workflow_dispatch(release_tag)\"}}:::gate
T_MANUAL --> GATE
ART_HUB_RELEASE -.->|\"image for tag must exist\"| GATE

%% ---------- STAGE 5: production deploy ----------
J_DEPLOY[\"job: deploy<br/>tool: appleboy/ssh-action → just deploy-prod<br/>env: production\"]:::job
ART_BACKUP[(\"prod server disk:<br/>./backups/prod_backup_&lt;timestamp&gt;.sql\")]:::artifact
GATE --> J_DEPLOY
ART_HUB_RELEASE -.->|\"compose pulls image\"| J_DEPLOY
J_DEPLOY --> ART_BACKUP
J_DEPLOY --> N_DEPLOY

N_DEPLOY[\"job: notify-deploy<br/>tool: discord-notify.yml\"]:::notify
N_DEPLOY --> DISCORD

%% ---------- STAGE 6: production health check ----------
J_PHCHECK[\"job: prod-health-check<br/>tool: curl retry loop<br/>env: production\"]:::job
ART_LASTGOOD[(\"prod server disk:<br/>.last_good_tag\")]:::artifact
J_DEPLOY -->|\"needs: deploy (success)\"| J_PHCHECK
J_PHCHECK -->|\"on success\"| ART_LASTGOOD
J_PHCHECK --> N_PHCHECK

N_PHCHECK[\"job: notify-prod-health-check<br/>tool: discord-notify.yml\"]:::notify
N_PHCHECK --> DISCORD

%% ---------- STAGE 7: automatic rollback (failure path) ----------
J_ROLLBACK[\"job: rollback-prod<br/>tool: appleboy/ssh-action → just rollback-prod<br/>env: production\"]:::job
J_PHCHECK -.->|\"failure()\"| J_ROLLBACK
ART_LASTGOOD -.->|\"read rollback target\"| J_ROLLBACK
J_ROLLBACK --> N_ROLLBACK

N_ROLLBACK[\"job: notify-rollback<br/>tool: discord-notify.yml\"]:::notify
N_ROLLBACK --> DISCORD",
